_comment: Run-level defaults and per-measurement limits for the anchor-1 yield envelopes (issue #244). target_yield 0.99 and target_ci_halfwidth 0.01 are the sizing argument in README.md 'Sample size' (N=400, zero failures -> Clopper-Pearson lower bound 0.9908; Wald half-width 0.0097 at yield 0.99). Limits are quoted from spec/target-spec.md: row 1 band 4.5-5.5 GHz, row 2 ratio >= 1.15, row 7 swing >= 0.40 V. Per-measurement entries here mirror the inline limits; the inline copy travels with the sample set, this file is the single place the run defaults live.
